entities.name: Query protein (403 aa)
observations: 403-aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 43.26 kDa and pI 6.68.
Strong Pfam matches: flavoprotein PF02441 at residues 2–175 and DFP PF04127 at residues 185–397.

Near-full-length CoaBC homologs (41.5–44% identity, ~98% query coverage) support a likely bifunctional CoA-biosynthesis role: phosphopantothenate:cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase; Mg2+ and FMN are listed for reference CoaBC proteins, not experimentally demonstrated for this query.
A close homolog is annotated as cysteine/cysteine-sulfinic-acid decarboxylase; exact substrate specificity and catalytic activity are not experimentally established for this query.
